summary.tag: Cách nói “muốn” một cách lịch sự
summary.formula: would like to + V / want to + V
summary.usage: Would like lịch sự hơn want; cả hai có to trước động từ.
summary.example: I would like to become an engineer.
summary.exampleVi: Tôi muốn trở thành kỹ sư.

summary.tag: Cấu trúc nói về dự định
summary.formula: plan to + V / be going to + V
summary.usage: Phân biệt plan to và be going to, không trộn hai mẫu.
summary.example: Lan plans to design safer houses.
summary.exampleVi: Lan dự định thiết kế những ngôi nhà an toàn hơn.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Mai would like ___ an engineer so she can design safer bridges.
items.why: Would like to + V; to become diễn tả nguyện vọng.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Nam wants ___ a doctor and help people in his town.
items.why: Want to + động từ nguyên mẫu.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Our class plans ___ the science museum next month.
items.why: Plan to + V là cấu trúc diễn tả dự định.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Lan is going to ___ her grandparents this summer.
items.why: Be going to + nguyên mẫu visit.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: My brother ___ to become a pilot when he grows up.
items.why: Brother số ít; hiện tại đơn dùng wants to become.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: We are going ___ a poster about helpful jobs.
items.why: Are going to + V; không bỏ to.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: "What would you like ___ in the future?" asks the teacher.
items.why: Would like to + V, nên to do.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Mai ___ going to interview a farmer for her school project.
items.why: Mai số ít dùng is going to + interview.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: The children plan ___ their neighbours clean the park.
items.why: Plan to + V; phần sau help somebody + V.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: I would like to ___ an honest person who helps others.
items.why: Sau would like to là động từ nguyên mẫu be.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Which sentence expresses a plan already arranged?
options: We are going to visit the farm on Friday.
items.answer: We are going to visit the farm on Friday.
items.why: Be going to diễn tả kế hoạch; ba câu kia chỉ quá khứ, thói quen và hành động hiện tại.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 11 · Grammar
items.scene: Lan ___ to design a new playground, so she is drawing ideas.
items.why: Lan là chủ ngữ số ít nên plans to design.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.
